_comment: Host hook stdin fixtures (plan doc/plan-landscape-recommendations.md §5). provenance: 'observed' = captured from a real host run; 'doc-derived' = built from the vendor's primary docs on the date given, not yet seen from a real host. commandPath locates the shell command: each element is an object key, except the literal "<json>", which means the value at that point is a JSON-encoded string to decode first. A null commandPath means the event carries no command (observe-only events). Replace a doc-derived file with a real capture when one exists (plan task H1) and flip its provenance.
